subject: Justed watched it.
author: SUFFUR
body:
Where did the airport go, and the bottom of the map has gone too?  DLC to come? or unlockable, or just dropped, Mr DJ Atomica? Lone Peak is back, or should I say Peaks, which is nice. Big surf, Water front and Downtown are also in appearance which is even better. Not nice to see, the advertizing is back. I wonder if it will be like Rainbow 6 vegas in the toilets of LUV, and updated once in a while? The map has changed a little bit too?(see opening of blog) 30 square KM of space, with a eye wheel, in a place similar to Los 'whatever' from Crackdown, lol. Some nice car stunts and stuff, we could create a stunt team, like the Red Arrows, lol.

It looks like you take all the games they have done and throw it all together, with a lot of work mind, and theres Paradise!

Now if Xambietru, would tell us how it handles, I would feel happier? But since they have a gag reflex, they say nothing, in case they spill some carrots they have not eaten, lol.

But its looking great so far.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
